scores.notes: In both images Sherlock Holmes (on the bed at left, tapping the pavement in the center at right) is the same tall, lean, clean-shaven middle-aged man with a sharp aquiline nose, gaunt cheeks, pale skin, and dark hair visible under his top hat on the right.

Daniel (standing center-left in the lions' den at left and addressing the king in the center at right) has the exact same short cropped grey-white hair, neat short grey beard, weathered olive skin, age, and medium build.

Viewed from the same side of the table (Alice on the left facing the Hare and Hatter on the right), the house behind the tea table conflicts: it is a red-brick ivy-covered cottage with a gabled porch on the left, but a smooth pale cream plaster house with rectangular sash windows on the right, and the tree trunk switches from left to right.

Sherlock Holmes (standing right of the doorway at left and on the pawnbroker's doorstep at right) is clearly the same tall, gaunt, clean-shaven middle-aged man with a prominent sharp nose, sunken cheeks, pale skin, and dark swept-back hair with receding temples.

Moses (walking center-left foreground with a staff at left and seated on the hilltop rock between Aaron and Hur at right) shares the same elderly weathered face, shoulder-length white hair, full white beard, tanned skin, and lean-medium build.

Moses (standing on the rocky outcrop on the left shore at left and seated on the stone at center right) has the same elderly appearance, long white hair, full white beard, tanned weathered skin, and lean-medium build.

Dr. Watson (seated in the armchair at left and entering through the doorway wearing a bowler hat at right) is the same middle-aged man with fair skin, thick dark brown handlebar mustache, clean-shaven chin, strong jaw, and sturdy medium build.

Jesus (standing center-left before Lazarus's tomb at left and seated beside the beach fire at far right) is the same man in his thirties with shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, neat full dark brown beard, olive skin, matching facial profile, and lean-medium build.

Moses (on the foreground left cliff in profile at left and walking forward at center foreground at right) is the same elderly man with windswept medium-long white hair, full white beard, weathered tanned skin, and lean-medium build.

On the left Moses sits facing forward between Aaron and Hur, but on the right he stands small in the midground on a cliff facing away toward the dark sea, leaving his face and beard turned away and obscured so identity cannot be reliably judged.

Alice (standing in the hallway drinking from the bottle at left and holding the flamingo on the croquet lawn at right) is the same young girl with long wavy golden-blonde hair, fair skin, round youthful face, and slight build.

Both images show the same dry sandy-and-rocky seabed corridor stretching straight ahead between towering curling blue-green walls of water, bordered by red-brown desert cliffs along the left shore under an overcast sky.

David (stepping across the brook on the left at left and standing on the right after striking Goliath at right) is the same young teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, clean-shaven youthful profile, lightly tanned olive skin, and slim athletic build.

David (kneeling at center to be anointed at left and leaping toward the doorway at far right to dodge Saul's spear at right) has the same short curly dark brown hair, clean-shaven youthful face, fair-olive skin, apparent teen age, and slender build.

David (standing left of the fallen Goliath at left and crouching at foreground right by the brook at right) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, fair rosy-cheeked skin, and slim build.

Allowing for opposite viewpoints (stern on the right at left, stern on the left at right), both images depict the same planked wooden fishing boat with a central mast, rigging, and rope-wrapped sternpost tossed on dark turbulent waves beneath heavy storm clouds with rocky brown hills on the horizon.

Both show the same dark ribbed wooden fishing boat with a central wooden mast, tan canvas sail rigged to the right, and heavy coiled ropes on dark blue-green water with rocky hills along the far-left horizon, differing only in the requested shift between raging storm (right) and breaking clouds (left).

The left image shows the burning white house and its gravel drive up close, whereas the right image is set at Eyford railway station with only a distant plume of black smoke rising behind trees; too little of the house and its grounds is visible on the right to judge.

David (ducking out the doorway at right-center in the left image and crouching at foreground right by the brook in the right image) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, fair-olive skin, and slim build.

Sherlock Holmes (seated left examining a photograph at left and seated right in the train carriage at right) is the exact same gaunt, clean-shaven middle-aged man with a sharp aquiline nose, sunken cheeks, pale skin, dark swept-back hair with receding temples, and lean build.
Both images depict the same subterranean brick-vaulted bank cellar with arched brick ceilings, uneven stone flagstone floors, stacks of wooden crates lining the walls, and dim lantern light.
Both images show the same rolling, furrowed green croquet lawn enclosed by a tan stone-and-brick garden wall backed by tall trees and dense hedges under a bright partly cloudy sky.

The left image shows the winding dirt road approaching a compound of pale cream flat-roofed stone houses beside cypress trees on terraced olive hills, and the right image shows the courtyard of that matching pale stone flat-roofed house looking out over the same terraced olive hillsides and cypress trees.

Alice (towering in the courtroom at left and holding the flamingo on the croquet ground at right) is the same young girl with long wavy golden-blonde hair, fair skin, dark headband, round youthful features, and matching apparent age.

Dr. Watson (seated on the bedroom chair at left and entering the study in a bowler hat at right) is the same middle-aged man with fair skin, a thick dark brown mustache, clean-shaven chin, matching facial structure, and medium-stocky build.

Simon Peter (standing right of the courtyard fire at left and reaching down center-right at the temple gate to raise the lame man at right) is the same rugged middle-aged man with thick short curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short full greying beard, tanned weathered skin, and sturdy build.

Dr. Watson (standing in the doorway holding a bowler hat at left and seated in the dark bedroom wearing the bowler hat at right) is the same middle-aged man with fair-ruddy skin, thick brown handlebar mustache, clean-shaven chin, heavy brow, and sturdy medium build.

Simon Peter (stepping out of the boat onto the waves at left and leaping from the right side of the boat toward shore at right) is the exact same rugged middle-aged man with short curly dark salt-and-pepper hair, a short thick greying beard, tanned weathered face, and broad muscular build.

Sherlock Holmes (standing left of the doorway pulling Watson in at left and seated left examining a photograph at right) is the exact same tall, lean, clean-shaven middle-aged man with a sharp aquiline nose, hollow cheeks, and dark swept-back hair with receding temples.

Both images show the exact same planked wooden boat with a central mast, rigging, and rope-wrapped sternpost on the right with a rolled cushion, with matching rocky brown hills on the right horizon, differing only in the text-requested change from storm (right) to calm (left).

Moses (walking center-left through the parted sea with a staff at left and standing center by the gushing rock with raised rod at right) is the same elderly man with medium-long white hair, full white beard, weathered tanned face, and lean-medium build.

Both images depict the same Judean hillside setting of pale tan flat-roofed stone-block houses, low stone walls, and rocky dirt paths set amid terraced slopes dotted with olive trees and distant ridges.

David (kneeling center-left to be anointed by Samuel at left and stepping across the brook at right) is the same clean-shaven young teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, tanned olive skin, matching profile, and slim athletic build.

Moses (standing center-left beside the gushing rock at left and on the left rocky bluff stretching his rod over the parting sea at right) is the same elderly man with medium-long white hair, full white beard, weathered tanned face, and lean-medium build.

The Cheshire Cat (floating head in the upper left above the croquet ground at left and perched on a mossy branch at upper right in the right image) is the same grey-brown striped tabby cat with matching forehead and cheek stripes, pointed ears, and a wide toothy grin.

Jesus (standing in the boat's stern calming the storm at left and standing beside the shore fire at right) is the exact same man in his thirties with shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, a neat full dark brown beard, olive skin, matching facial profile, and lean-medium build.

Simon Peter (stepping over the boat's side onto the water at left and bending center-right at the temple gate to lift the lame man at right) is the exact same rugged middle-aged man with short curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short full greying beard, tanned weathered skin, and sturdy build.

Jesus (walking on the stormy water at left and seated beside the beach fire on the far right at right) is the same man in his thirties with shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, full dark brown beard, olive skin, and lean-medium build.

David (escaping through the doorway on the right in the left image and standing by the brook holding a staff in the right image) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, fair-olive skin, and slim build.

Dr. Watson (standing right of Holmes in Saxe-Coburg Square wearing a bowler hat at left and seated in the bedroom chair at far right in the right image) is the same middle-aged man with fair skin, a thick dark brown handlebar mustache, clean-shaven chin, and sturdy medium build.

Simon Peter (standing center foreground in the courtyard at left and stepping out of the boat onto the waves at right) is the exact same rugged middle-aged man with short curly salt-and-pepper hair, a short thick greying beard, weathered tanned face, and broad sturdy build.

Jesus (crouching by the shore fire on the right in the left image and standing on the sea waves on the right in the right image) is the same man in his thirties with shoulder-length wavy dark brown hair, neat full dark brown beard, olive skin, and lean-medium build.

Alice (crouching giant in the courtroom at left and standing beside the mushroom looking at the Caterpillar at right) is the same young girl with long wavy golden-blonde hair, headband, fair skin, round youthful face, and matching apparent age.

David (crouching in the foreground right beside the brook at left and kneeling center-right to be anointed by Samuel at right) is the same clean-shaven teenage boy with short curly dark brown hair, fair rosy-cheeked skin, and slim build.
